entries.title: Business verification for every store
entries.need: Staff could not check a store's trade licence, TIN or owner's NID, and nothing showed which stores were real.
entries.now: Owners send their licence, TIN, NID and photos from Settings; staff approve or reject them in a review queue, and the state shows everywhere.
entries.where: Merchant: Settings › Business verification (/set-verification) · Super admin: Merchants › Verification (/admin/kyc), merchant profile
try: In the merchant panel open Settings › Business verification and send the form with two photos
In the super admin open Merchants › Verification and approve or reject it
Open Dazzle Shop's profile and see the Verification card
Back in Settings the shop shows Verified or the reason it was rejected
entries.left: Photos are kept as file names only; a server must store the files and check the numbers.

entries.title: Announcements inside the merchant panel
entries.need: GridCommerce had no way to tell stores about news or planned downtime inside their panel.
entries.now: Staff write, schedule and stop notices for all stores, a plan, an edition or chosen stores; shops see a banner and a What's new list.
entries.where: Super admin: Communications › Merchant notices (/admin/notices) · Merchant: banner under the top bar, account menu › What's new
try: In the super admin open Communications › Merchant notices and press New notice
Pick Maintenance, give the down time and publish
Open any merchant page: the banner shows under the top bar
Dismiss it, then open What's new from the account menu
entries.left: Dismissals are kept per person in this browser; a live build keeps them on the account.

entries.title: Health and last sign-in on Merchants
entries.need: Health was visible one store at a time, so nobody saw which stores were slipping away.
entries.now: The list shows each store's health and last sign-in, sorts by them, has an At risk view, and the dashboard counts at-risk stores.
entries.where: Super admin: Merchants › All merchants (/admin/merchants?view=risk) · Dashboard
try: Open All merchants and look at the Health and Last sign-in columns (right after Status)
Press the At risk tab: it opens sorted by health
Filter by an account manager to see their at-risk stores
On the Dashboard, open the At risk row in the Merchants card or the at-risk row under Needs someone today

entries.title: Failed automatic charges in Collections
entries.need: A failed bKash or card charge was hidden in one bill's history until the bill went overdue.
entries.now: Collections has an Auto-charge failed group with Retry now and Ask owner to update payment method, which logs it and sends the store a notice.
try: Open Collections: Mehedi Traders is under Auto-charge failed
Press Retry now and read the result
From the row's menu choose Ask owner to update payment method
Open the bill to see each try in its timeline
entries.left: The retry result is a demo; a live build calls bKash or the card gateway.

entries.title: VAT and billing details on bills
entries.need: Subscription bills had no VAT line and a store's BIN, invoice name and billing email could not be kept.
entries.now: New bills carry 15% VAT and the store's billing name, BIN and email; staff or the owner can change those details.
entries.where: Super admin: Billing & credits › Invoices › a bill; merchant profile › Billing details · Merchant: Settings › Business verification
try: Open a bill issued in the last few days: it has a VAT 15% line
Its Facts show who it is billed to; Print shows both BINs
On a merchant profile press Edit on Billing details and save a BIN
The next bill keeps the new details
entries.left: Bills issued before the rule started keep no VAT line.

entries.title: Returns and exchanges on the phone
entries.need: Every return in the app sent people to the web.
entries.now: The app finds the sale by number, mobile or a scan, takes items back, refunds or swaps them, and returns stock to sale or to damaged.
entries.where: App: More › Return or exchange (/m-return); POS › shift sheet
try: Open the app's POS, tap the shift, then Return or exchange
Search a sale or scan its receipt
Tick an item, pick a reason and Cash, then Confirm return
Try Exchange and pick another item
On an order page tap Return or exchange: the sale opens, and Back returns to the order
entries.left: Courier return parcels are still received on the web (/courier-returns).

entries.title: Today's cash card for managers
entries.need: On the phone the owner could not see where today's money was, and Finance and Home disagreed with no reason shown.
entries.now: Home and Finance show each open drawer's expected cash, today's pickups, shifts closed and the COD couriers still hold.
try: Sign in as the owner and open the app's Home
Find Today's cash under Needs you
Open Finance: the same card is under the figures
Tap COD with couriers to open Payouts
entries.left: A drawer open on another device only counts the sales this phone has seen.

entries.title: More of the phone app in Bangla
entries.need: Many lines with numbers and some labels stayed in English when the app was switched to Bangla.
entries.now: Stock, POS, Home and Finance lines with numbers and the remaining labels now show in Bangla, as do the new screens.
entries.where: App: Home, Stock, POS, Finance, Return or exchange
try: Switch the app to বাংলা on Home
Open Stock and a product: on hand, held and on the way read in Bangla
Open POS: the cart and charge buttons read in Bangla
Open Finance and Today's cash
entries.left: The order page and order list belong to the online work and were not changed here.

entries.title: Needs you rows open the right tab
entries.need: Send to courier on Home opened Orders on the first tab, not the ready-for-courier list.
entries.now: Verify orders opens the On hold tab and Send to courier opens the Ready for courier list.
try: Open the app's Home
Tap Send to courier
Orders opens on the ready list
